problem_type: Creation ports require host independent canonical project ownership
symptom: Web AI production cannot read/write canonical creation documents or materialize production candidates without an Electron renderer
direct_cause: Original project creation and production landing owners close over global renderer stores
class_root: Canonical creation algorithms and project persistence are not separated from the UI session adapter
affected_population: Browser disconnected or unopened creation editor, desktop renderer, external agent creation
entry_points: Native agent script writing and storyboard authoring
Production canvas landing and reconnect projection
internal_only_reason: Canonical Nomi project persistence and renderer ownership are internal contracts.
invariants: Both hosts use the identical canonical text schema and document write algorithm.
Materialization preserves candidate revision, detached nodes, existing selections and user-owned running generation.
Every server write is serialized and expectedBinding pinned.

door_reduction.why_not: Document reading/writing, rich text schema, storyboard authoring and production landing adapters are separate domain entry points; desktop and web adapters delegate to the same canonical owner rather than removing required entry points.

generality_proof: Canonical algorithms execute through injected project/canvas state, avoiding global focused project or DOM dependencies for every host.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Shared markdown, canonical schema text and whole-document write.
Shared idempotent candidate landing and generation outcome semantics.
Canonical group membership and geometry without renderer undo/event side effects.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Baseline renderer document port reexports and calls canonical extracted core.
Desktop landing becomes the injected adapter of the same shared landing core.

recurrence.reason: Every automatic script and multi-shot turn can hit missing renderer ownership.
same_class_scan: read documentSessionPort, agentStoryboardDesign and multiShotCanvasLanding owners

prevention.invariant: Project-pinned ports use one canonical mutation owner on both hosts.
prevention.strategy: Extract canonical algorithms and inject host-specific state/persistence boundaries.

legacy_paths.rationale: Algorithm copies removed from adapters and moved to shared owners in the same change.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: Existing Tiptap schema and Nomi domain owners retained; this is host adapter extraction.

migration: Existing persisted documents and candidate metadata remain identical; no data migration.
residual_risks: Browser and GPU evidence must be provided by coordinator before merge.
